title: Source-push browser gates read a pinned data snapshot; live data moves to watchdog-browser
changelog: **Pinned browser data (v59.70):** the CI browser shards no longer read whatever the data bot committed last. `architecture/browser-data-fixture.json` pins one commit's deployed public-data (959 files, PAGES_DATA_EXCLUDES left out, each with its git blob id and key structure); ci.yml restores it from actions/cache (key = pinned commit + manifest hash), fetches and materializes it on a miss, installs it over the throwaway checkout after checking every blob id, and sets the page clock (`AIO_BROWSER_CLOCK_AT`, served by start-local-node as `./__aio-clock.js` first in `<head>`) to the pin's commit time. The workspace gate `browser-data-fixture` fails when a producer's artifact leaves the pinned key structure (new or dropped keys at depth 3; empty arrays, map keys and null/number swaps are not drift) and names `node scripts/browser-data-fixture.mjs pin`. `watchdog-browser.yml` runs the same six browser groups on live data at 07:47Z and 22:47Z and alerts through operations-alert.yml. The Chromium setup moved unchanged into `.github/actions/setup-browser-gates`, shared by both.

qa.text: v59.70: browser-data-fixture check passes on the pinned snapshot, fails with the pin command on an added key, replays empty-array/map/null tolerance, verifies the page clock script and the ci.yml / watchdog-browser.yml / operations-alert.yml wiring

note: change-only (no P): 2nd batch A item (2). Pinned at 140ba22c on the branch; re-pinned at integration to 23900c3a (wave2-e, the last commit that changed public-data: 4 new research artifacts), which CI can fetch once the batch is pushed. Measured on data-bot commits: depth 3 + tolerance found 0 drifting files over 30 min and 3 over 19 h, all three real producer changes (event-briefs, filing-discovery, telegram-digest fields). The 4 browser gates that also read public-data from disk see the pinned files because the snapshot is installed in place, not overlaid (AIO_BROWSER_DATA_ROOT stays for local runs). Node-side Date.now in two browser gates (browser-screener-refresh, browser-out-of-universe-ticker) is not shifted.
